verdict.rationale: Fathom's API/SDKs support listing meetings, filtering by team, pagination, and downloading/transcribing recordings, which lets an AI-native user script iteration over many items, but there is no documented native bulk endpoint (e.g., batch update, bulk delete, multi-item request) — bulk-style workflows require manual looping via the API. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints, documented rate limits or batching support for large-scale operations, and evidence of bulk write/update/delete operations rather than just read/list/paginate.
